mapper.select: SELECT use_yn FROM prj.prj WHERE prj_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM cst.drct_expns e WHERE e.prj_id=#{id} AND e.dev_id IS NULL ORDER BY e.expns_ym DESC,e.expns_id DESC
SELECT FROM cst.drct_expns e WHERE e.prj_id=#{projectId} AND e.expns_id=#{expenseId} AND e.dev_id IS NULL
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cmn.cd_dtl d JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=d.cd_grp_id WHERE d.cd_grp_id='EXPENSE_ITEM' AND d.dtl_cd=#{code} AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y')
SELECT cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_ym=#{month}
mapper.update: UPDATE cst.drct_expns SET expns_ym=#{input.expns_ym},expns_item_cd=#{input.expns_item_cd}, expns_amt=#{input.expns_amt},vat_amt=#{input.vat_amt},pay_dt=#{input.pay_dt}, rmrk_desc=#{input.rmrk_desc},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE prj_id=#{projectId} AND expns_id=#{expenseId} AND dev_id IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cst.drct_expns WHERE prj_id=#{projectId} AND expns_id=#{expenseId} AND dev_id IS NULL
